title: Spacecraft Lounge Interior Designer
description: The user is an interior architect tasked with furnishing a spacecraft hallway lounge area. They must place, rotate, and recolor multiple instances of a sheen chair within the hallway while respecting a strict weight budget that acts as a conservation constraint. Full undo/redo support lets them experiment freely.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a spacecraft interior design tool. Load space_ship_hallway.glb as the environment centered at origin and SheenChair.glb as the furniture asset. Camera: use OrbitControls starting inside the hallway looking down its length, with constrained zoom (min 2, max 15). Lighting: one warm-white PointLight inside the hallway, one cool-blue AmbientLight for sci-fi atmosphere, and a subtle RectAreaLight simulating ceiling panels. Core mechanics: The user has a toolbar (HTML overlay) with buttons: Add Chair, Delete Selected, Rotate CW 45deg, Rotate CCW 45deg, Cycle Color (5 preset sheen tints: silver, crimson, teal, gold, violet), Undo, and Redo. A weight budget display shows current/max capacity (max 600 kg, each chair weighs a random amount between 40-80 kg assigned on creation). This is the conservation law: total placed chair weight must never exceed 600 kg. Adding a chair beyond budget shows a warning flash on the HUD. Chairs spawn at a default position along the hallway center line with slight random Z offset. The user clicks a chair to select it (highlight with emissive outline), then uses toolbar actions. Dragging a selected chair with mouse repositions it on the hallway floor plane using raycasting against an invisible ground plane at y=0. Each action (add, delete, move, rotate, recolor) pushes to an undo stack storing full state snapshots (position, rotation, color, weight per chair). Undo pops and restores previous state, redo re-applies. The HUD also shows chair count and a mini-map top-down view rendered with a second orthographic camera in a corner inset (150x150px canvas). Minimum interaction path to complete a furnished lounge: add 4 chairs (4 steps), reposition 2 (2 steps), rotate 2 (2 steps), recolor 2 (2 steps), undo one placement and redo it (2 steps) totaling 12 steps. All geometry must cast and receive shadows with renderer.shadowMap enabled.
